OF ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING · IIT ROORKEE</span>    <span>CYBER SECURITY CHALLENGES IN DISTRIBUTION POWER NETWORKS · 27.10.2026</span>  </div></footer></div> <script>(function(){  var target = Date.UTC(2026,9,27,5,0,0), el = document.getElementById('cd');  function tick(){    var d = target - Date.now();    if (d <= 0){ el.textContent = 'LIVE'; return; }    var days = Math.floor(d/864e5), h = Math.floor(d%864e5/36e5), m = Math.floor(d%36e5/6e4);    el.textContent = days+'d '+String(h).padStart(2,'0')+'h '+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+'m';  }  tick(); setInterval(tick, 30000);   var c = document.getElementById('net'), ctx = c.getContext('2d'), W, H, nodes = [], N, dpr = Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1, 2);  var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;  function resize(){ W = c.width = innerWidth*dpr; H = c.height = innerHeight*dpr; N = Math.min(90, Math.floor(innerWidth/14)); nodes = []; for (var i=0;i<N;i++) nodes.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.25*dpr,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.25*dpr}); }  function draw(){    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);    var link = 150*dpr;    for (var i=0;i<N;i++){ var a=nodes[i]; if(!reduce){a.x+=a.vx;a.y+=a.vy; if(a.x<0||a.x>W)a.vx*=-1; if(a.y<0||a.y>H)a.vy*=-1;}      for (var j=i+1;j<N;j++){ var b=nodes[j], dx=a.x-b.x, dy=a.y-b.y, d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy); if(d<link){ ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(46,168,255,'+(0.18*(1-d/link)).toFixed(3)+')'; ctx.lineWidth=dpr; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y); ctx.stroke(); } } }    for (var k=0;k<N;k++){ var n=nodes[k]; ctx.fillStyle='rgba(143,227,255,.7)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(n.x,n.y,1.6*dpr,0,6.283); ctx.fill(); }    if(!reduce) requestAnimationFrame(draw);  }  addEventListener('resize', function(){ resize(); if(reduce) draw(); });  resize(); draw();})();</script> </body></html>
